# Pixel Memory Match

A fully offline, accessible memory match game built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

## How to Play

- Click or tap a card to flip it.
- Flip two cards at a time to find matching pairs.
- Matched pairs stay open.
- The move counter tracks your attempts.
- Match all 8 pairs to win!

## Features

- 8 pairs of colored cards (16 cards total).
- Move counter and win message.
- New Game button to reset.
- Keyboard accessible: cards are buttons, focusable with Tab and activated with Enter/Space.
- Responsive layout from 360px wide.
- Cohesive palette and system fonts.
- No external dependencies or network requests.

## Run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server required.

## Files

- `index.html` – structure and semantic markup.
- `style.css` – styling, palette, responsive layout, hover/focus/pressed states.
- `game.js` – game logic: shuffle, flip, match, move counter, win condition, reset.

## Accessibility

- Cards have ARIA labels that update on flip/match.
- Win message uses `role="alert"` and `aria-live`.
- Focus outlines are visible.
- Buttons are used for all interactive elements.
